target-format.description: Explicit interpretation: dos-com or raw-binary (headerless), or gamecube-dol (GameCube/Wii DOL, never auto-detected); omission preserves header-based detection

architecture.description: Caller-supplied CPU family; required with --target-format raw-binary, must be omitted with gamecube-dol

entry-point.description: Caller-supplied load and entry address (0xhex); required with --target-format raw-binary, optional with gamecube-dol (must equal the DOL header entry)

provider.description: Bind deep analysis to a provider ID or use deterministic auto selection
